title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：store　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 store 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the trader ① kept the store that no partner in the market would have measured, and he said the keeping was the whole of the week. The ② store, meaning the shop itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a store, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ store in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ store at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A store, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the trader said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the store was the whole of the matter, meaning the stock and not the shop. The ⑥ store, meaning the stock and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; store, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a shop and a stock. He said the stock is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ store had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ store of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of measuring; store, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ store I remember is the shop measured in the list, which closed in 2000 and is still measured as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ store, my mother said in 2002, is the only shop that improves by being measured; every store, she said, is a stock that has agreed to look like a shop. She said the stock was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 商店；储备（指集市里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 商店；储备（指那家商店本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the store 存这一家商店
D. n. 商店；储备（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 商店之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的商店之事）
F. n. 商店；储备（指货单里写到、被测量的那一家）
G. n. 商店、存货（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 存货（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the store that no partner in the market would have measured
The store, meaning the shop itself and not the basket
the store at the far stall
the store was the whole of the matter
the store had become a line in a list
The store of the whole thing
A store, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: keep the store 意为“存这一家商店”，1993 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯测量的一家商店做了一遍。
store 意为“商店；储备”，指那家商店本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
store 意为“商店；储备”，指集市里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
store 意为“商店；储备”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
store 意为“商店、存货”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这家存货就是那件事的全部。
store 意为“存货”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家商店，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
store 意为“商店；储备”，指货单里写到、被测量的那一家，到 1998 年这一家成了货单里的一行。
store 意为“商店之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的商店之事是一处集市和三个星期的测量。
store 意为“商店；储备”，我记得的是货单里测量过的那一家，2000 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一家。
store 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，商店是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的商店。
